_comment: The Hall of Fame (work order 188 Part 6). Its words are ARTWORK in the original — SCORE.LBX entry 15 carries the title and the rank numbers 1-10 beside the rows (seen on the native frame, work order 188: the picture has NO column headers, which the source reading had assumed) — so the title is typed here per decision 15, the numbers are drawn, and a mod replaces this file.

marks.deviation_hud_table: The table in HUD panels on the universal background, where the original draws SCORE.LBX 15's picture (title, header and its own frame) with its own cursor (SCORE.LBX 16).
marks.deviation_flash: The new entry flashes as a lit row blinking at the original's pace (every 6 draw ticks, score.cpp:397-405), where the original cycles the row's palette colours.
marks.hd_extension_exit_button: A CLOSE button under the table; the original leaves on a click anywhere or ESC (its one full-screen field, score.cpp:549), which HD takes too.
marks.omission_reset_key: The original's 'C' key re-creates the default file on disk (score.cpp:329-334); HD never sends it — no key but ESC reaches the game from this screen.
